meta.title: Apartment 14
meta.tagline: At 02:14, someone says your name in the hallway. As you step through the door of your new apartment, you sink deeper into a building that grows stranger and stranger.

strings.d14.s01.body: You wake up with a start. In the hallway, someone says your name. A light passes under your door.
strings.d14.s02.title: Cold Handle
strings.d14.s02.body: The handle is cold and damp. If you turn it, you will not be able to pretend nothing is wrong anymore.
strings.d14.s02.c2: Pull your hand back and listen
strings.d14.s03.title: At the Door
strings.d14.s03.body: You are standing in front of the door. In the middle, there is a peephole to look through. You can feel someone on the other side.
strings.d14.s04.title: Silent Phone
strings.d14.s04.body: Your phone gets no signal. You hear footsteps… then nothing.
strings.d14.s05.title: Footprints
strings.d14.s05.body: On the floor, you see wet footprints. They lead toward the stairs.
strings.d14.s05.c2: Follow the footprints to a door
strings.d14.s06.title: Frozen Lock
strings.d14.s06.body: Cold air comes out of the keyhole. The lock is freezing cold, as if the door were breathing.
strings.d14.s07.title: Inside the Tiny Hole
strings.d14.s07.body: You see a shape at the end of the hallway. It does not move.
strings.d14.s07.c1: Open the door just a little
strings.d14.s07.c2: Turn off your light and step back
strings.d14.s08.title: Window Across
strings.d14.s08.body: Rain runs down the glass. Across from you, some windows are lit. But here, you feel trapped.
strings.d14.s09.title: Dirty Stairwell
strings.d14.s09.body: The stairwell is damp and dirty. The farther down you go, the heavier the air feels.
strings.d14.s10.title: Identical Hallway
strings.d14.s10.body: The hallway looks the same everywhere. All the doors are identical.
strings.d14.s10.c1: Go to the door at the end
strings.d14.s11.title: Flashlight and Dust
strings.d14.s11.body: With the flashlight, you can see dust in the air. It helps… but it can also attract attention.
strings.d14.s12.title: Proof
strings.d14.s12.body: A shape appears on the screen. This is not a dream.
strings.d14.s12.c1: Go to the lobby with it
strings.d14.s13.title: Lobby
strings.d14.s13.body: Broken intercom. Damaged mailboxes. Everything is old. You feel like someone is listening to you.
strings.d14.s14.title: Door at the End
strings.d14.s14.body: At the end of the hallway, a dark door. You can feel that this is a bad sign.
strings.d14.s15.title: SERVICE Area
strings.d14.s15.body: A SERVICE sign hangs crooked. Here, it no longer feels like a normal place.
strings.d14.s16.title: Too White a Light
strings.d14.s16.body: A very white light spills out from a half-open door. It is too clean, and that makes it terrifying.
strings.d14.s17.title: Small Floor Door
strings.d14.s17.body: Inside the room, you see a small door in the floor. A metal ring sticks out.
strings.d14.s18.title: Very Long Hallway
strings.d14.s18.body: The hallway never seems to end. Whenever you look away, it seems even longer.
strings.d14.s18.c2: Go back toward the white door
strings.d14.s19.title: Open Locker
strings.d14.s19.body: Inside a locker, there is a badge and a paper. As if someone had left it there for you.
strings.d14.s19.c3: Use the badge on a SERVICE door
strings.d14.s20.title: Concrete Space
strings.d14.s20.body: A large concrete area with several doors. You feel that you are not welcome here.
strings.d14.s20.c1: Take a door that leads downward
strings.d14.s21.title: Wet Badge
strings.d14.s21.body: The badge is damp and cold. You grip it tightly in your hand.
strings.d14.s21.c1: Use the badge on the door
strings.d14.s22.title: Dark Hallway
strings.d14.s22.body: Under the building, everything is wet. The pipes make noise all around you.
strings.d14.s22.c1: Go to the door at the end
strings.d14.s22.c3: Go back to the concrete space
strings.d14.s23.title: Key on the Table
strings.d14.s23.body: Inside the room, a key lies on a table. Farther away, the small floor door is there.
strings.d14.s23.c2: Go down through the small door
strings.d14.s24.title: Before the Beep
strings.d14.s24.body: You hold the badge up to the door. One second passes… then a beep.
strings.d14.s25.title: Reflections
strings.d14.s25.body: The floor shines like a mirror. You see your reflection… then another one behind it.
strings.d14.s26.title: Restricted Access
strings.d14.s26.body: The doors are lined up. You are not supposed to be here.
strings.d14.s26.c1: Go to the door that is breathing
strings.d14.s27.title: The Door Is Breathing
strings.d14.s27.body: Cold smoke comes out of the handle. This door is hiding something.
strings.d14.s27.c3: Go back to the concrete space
strings.d14.s28.title: Code Keypad
strings.d14.s28.body: A code keypad. The light is red. The badge is not enough. You need a key.
strings.d14.s28.c1: Go back the way you came
strings.d14.s29.title: Living Pipes
strings.d14.s29.body: The pipes are vibrating. Steam sticks to your face. You keep going down.
strings.d14.s30.title: Heavy Key
strings.d14.s30.body: The key is heavy and old. It feels like it opens only one door.
strings.d14.s30.c1: Keep the key and move forward
strings.d14.s31.title: The Set
strings.d14.s31.body: Badge and key. You understand that all of this was prepared for you.
strings.d14.s31.c1: Go back to the code keypad
strings.d14.s31.c3: Go back to the concrete space
strings.d14.s32.title: It Opens
strings.d14.s32.body: The key turns. The light turns green. The door opens without a sound.
strings.d14.s32.c3: Go back to the concrete space
strings.d14.s33.title: Narrow Hallway
strings.d14.s33.body: The ceiling is low. Cables hang down. You can hear your own breathing.
strings.d14.s34.title: Half-Open Door
strings.d14.s34.body: A thin line of light. No sound. As if someone were waiting.
strings.d14.s35.title: Black Hole
strings.d14.s35.body: The small door goes down into darkness. The air is freezing cold.
strings.d14.s36.title: Torn Blueprints
strings.d14.s36.body: Blueprints are torn and scratched up. Someone was looking for a way out.
strings.d14.s37.title: Behind the Glass
strings.d14.s37.body: The glass is white with fog. Behind it, a shape is very close.
strings.d14.s38.title: Camera
strings.d14.s38.body: The camera sees more than your eyes do. On the screen, the hallway seems to move.
strings.d14.s38.c3: Follow the breathing in the walls
strings.d14.s39.title: Air in the Walls
strings.d14.s39.body: Inside the air vent, you hear a steady breathing. At times, it sounds like your name.
strings.d14.s39.c1: Follow the breathing to the white area
strings.d14.s39.c3: Go back to the narrow hallway
strings.d14.s40.title: Too Clean
strings.d14.s40.body: Everything is white and spotless. It looks like a hospital. It is terrifying.
strings.d14.s40.c3: Follow the white hallway to the archives
strings.d14.s41.title: Surveillance
strings.d14.s41.body: Screens show the hallways. On one screen, you see your door upstairs.
strings.d14.s41.c3: Go back to the white hallway
strings.d14.s42.title: Control Room
strings.d14.s42.body: A camera watches you. You can take proof… or run.
strings.d14.s42.c2: Go back to the white hallway
strings.d14.s43.title: Archive Hallway
strings.d14.s43.body: Shelves, boxes, damp paper. The history of this place is here.
strings.d14.s43.c2: Go back to the control room
strings.d14.s44.title: Archive Aisle
strings.d14.s44.body: Boxes everywhere. You are looking for the number 14.
strings.d14.s45.title: Damaged File
strings.d14.s45.body: You pull out a file. Dust sticks to your fingers.
strings.d14.s46.title: Photos
strings.d14.s46.body: In one photo, a shape stands at the end of a hallway. Always the same one.
strings.d14.s47.title: FILE 14
strings.d14.s47.body: You find a thick file. The number “14” is on it. It is about the building.
strings.d14.s48.title: Torn Page
strings.d14.s48.body: A page was torn out recently. Someone wanted to hide something.
strings.d14.s49.title: EXIT
strings.d14.s49.body: A red sign points to the exit. You do not know if it is real.
strings.d14.s50.title: Your Name
strings.d14.s50.body: In the air, you hear your name. Behind you, footsteps follow your own.
strings.d14.end_good.title: ENDING — You Get Out
strings.d14.end_good.body: You slam the door, run down the stairs two at a time, and step out into the empty street. The air burns your lungs. When you look up at the window on your floor, there is nothing. No light. No silhouette. Just your reflection. You take nothing with you except one certainty: someone or something knew your name. And now you know the building kept it, and it will not forget you.
strings.d14.end_bad.title: ENDING — You Stay
strings.d14.end_bad.body: The hallway closes in. The light grows dim. You understand that you are not getting out. Your apartment is for rent, and you become one more shadow here.
strings.d14.end_secret.title: SECRET ENDING — Complete File
strings.d14.end_secret.body: You have the badge, the key, and the truth. The building traps people and turns them into shadows. You know it now, and you also know that you will never come back here.
strings.d14.h.clue.has_photo.title: Photo
strings.d14.h.clue.has_photo.desc: A photo that shows the shape.
strings.d14.h.clue.has_badge.title: Badge
strings.d14.h.clue.has_badge.desc: A badge to open certain doors.
strings.d14.h.clue.has_key.title: Key
strings.d14.h.clue.has_key.desc: A heavy key to open a door.
strings.d14.h.clue.has_recording.title: Video
strings.d14.h.clue.has_recording.desc: A video that proves you were not dreaming.
strings.d14.h.clue.has_dossier.title: File
strings.d14.h.clue.has_dossier.desc: The “14” file found in the archives.
